behavior-tests.source: The shipped while-enabled callbacks suppress both shooting-at-melee-range and shooting-into-melee penalties. Termination restores them.
behavior-tests.runtime: SharpshooterFreeFire samples current loaded membership, target weapon, distance and current opponents on ordinary shots. The implementation preserves the long-range edge and the existing base attack input.
behavior-tests.test: SharpshooterFreeFireTests verifies the callback-only loaded state, distance and opponent count rules. PR650 verifies loaded/unloaded near 0/-15, long-range +15, armed 0 and two opponents -30/0 with base attack input 27 throughout. The exact retail caller and distance policy remains under source-parity. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/650#issuecomment-7062181650

behavior-tests.source: Shipped 603 reduces pet action costs by 20 percent and increases pet Inner Strength regeneration by 50 percent for 600 seconds.
behavior-tests.runtime: CoderPets applies the timed bonus to the current owned pet and uses it in both action admission and resource regeneration. A later summon starts with its own resource state.
behavior-tests.test: CoderPetTests.ChargeChangesActualBudgetAndExpiresWithoutRetroactiveRegeneration verifies both multipliers, expiry and resource boundaries. PR649 records the normal cast's 35 IS debit, the 600-second bonuses on the active attacking Proxy and the baseline cost on replacement. The distinct AcousticDecoy1_GetRange source remains under script/source-parity. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/649#issuecomment-7062104777
